course_name_original: MANUTENZIONE DEI SISTEMI DI PRODUZIONE T (29762)
prerequisites: Prior knowledge and understanding of statistical distribution analysis (probability density function, cumulative function, etc) and integral calculation is required.
Fluent spoken and written Italian is a necessary pre-requisite.

learning_outcomes.text: Deal with the maintenance of a production system with a systemic and organic approach.
Present models and methods to support failure analysis and policies following RAMS theories (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety).

syllabus_topics: Introduction on maintenance of production systems
Design and management of maintenance division
Reliability, availability and maintainability of components and systems (with numerical applications)
Design of best mix of maintenance policies
Models for type I preventive strategy (with numerical applications)
Models for type II preventive strategy (with numerical applications)
Models and methods to forecast spare parts and policies of spare parts management (with numerical applications)
The role of the informative system in maintenance
Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and Global Service (GSM)
Overall equipment effectiveness index (with numerical applications)
teaching_methods: Software usage for reliability analysis and information management
assessment_rules: The final exam consists of a written exam divided into two sections: one based on numerical applications and the other on theoretical questions, with a duration of 3 hours. To pass, students must demonstrate knowledge of key concepts, critical application ability, and comprehensible technical language. Higher grades require an organic understanding of the subject and a high ability for critical application, especially in connecting different parts of the course. Books and manuscripts are not allowed during the exam, but scientific non-programmable calculators are permitted.
